set.commercial.notes: Patch round: Energy Trust Form 120HVAC v2026.2 — high-efficiency RTU replacement is deemed ONLY as a heat-pump replacement (ducted HP $350/ton; single-package HP CEE Tier 1 $200/ton; electric-resistance-to-HP retrofit $1,250-2,500/ton). A straight AC-to-AC RTU swap has no prescriptive line and routes to custom. Our Frontier heat-pump-class RTU fits the deemed HP-replacement measure. ARC $200-300/ton and smart thermostat $200-400/unit confirmed. Payment: 6-8 weeks after complete application; submit within 90 days of install.
